string-array.name: quotes_text
string-array.item: "In the middle of every difficulty lies opportunity. Prepare, respond, recover."
"Safety is not a gadget but a state of mind. Know your surroundings, trust your instincts."
"Disasters don\'t plan ahead — but you can. Every second of preparation counts."
"Community is the greatest emergency resource. Look after one another."
"Courage is not the absence of fear — it is acting despite it. Help is always within reach."
"A single alert shared on time can save an entire neighborhood. Information is protection."
"When the unexpected strikes, a calm mind is your greatest asset. Breathe. Act. Survive."
"No one is ever truly alone in a crisis. Reach out — help is closer than you think."
